messages:
Maya (Partnerships): Quick sync 10m: need a concise SI claim + contest rule for the IntegrateNow pilot. Pilot goes live tomorrow so want zero ambiguity.

Ethan (SI Ops): Cool. Do we have an agreed field set in SFDC for partner claims?

Maya (Partnerships): Proposed minimal fields: `rnw_partnership` (slug), `partner_claimed` (boolean), `claim_deadline` (date), `origin` (marketplace|direct|referral), `region`. Claim action should be a single SFDC task.

Clara (Sales): Also: contested ownerships. If AE touches the lead (any logged activity) within 7 days of creation, AE has priority. If AE has no activity and SI claims within the window, SI wins.

Diego (Marketplace): For marketplace leads, shorten the claim window to accelerate conversion: Tier M (marketplace) = 48h default. Non-marketplace: Tier 1 (>$1M) = 5 business days, Tier 2 = 48h, Tier 3 = 24h.

Ethan (SI Ops): We can implement a validation rule: when `rnw_partnership` is set, trigger claim window timer and create the task. Ill add saved view filters: `rnw_partnership != NULL AND partner_claimed = false`.

Rina (Legal): A few legal constraints: 1) If `nda_under_review` = true, lock claim action and notify Legal. 2) No co-sell or joint marketing claim until marketing + legal approve; mark `co_sell_approved` = false by default.

Maya (Partnerships): Good call. Also decide escalation: if SI claims but doesn't respond to outreach in 24h, auto-escalate to SI lead + AE. Add `escalation_email` field to task template.

Clara (Sales): For contested cases where AE opened a thread after SI claimed, AE and SI should resolve within 48h via the dispute channel; if unresolved, Partnerships arbitrates.

Diego (Marketplace): Tagging automation update: partner-bot will add `origin:marketplace` for marketplace-sourced leads. @partner-bot, what's current backlog?

partner-bot: Marketplace tagging active since 2025-11-10. Current open IntegrateNow leads = 9.

Ethan (SI Ops): I'll produce a 1-page play with: claim rules, SFDC filters, task template, escalation steps, and a short customer blurb. Will post to IntegrateNow Confluence space by EOD.

Maya (Partnerships): Customer-facing blurb draft: "Our partner IntegrateNow will coordinate implementation planning and next steps. Redwood will support technical coordination as needed." Keep it non-committal on commercial terms.

Rina (Legal): Replace "support" with "technical coordination" — avoid implying SLAs or pricing.

Clara (Sales): Minor: include a note that AEs can waive priority if they want the SI to own the account. Adds flexibility.

Ethan (SI Ops): Noted. I'll add waiver checkbox `ae_priority_waived` to the task.

Maya (Partnerships): OK final checklist: 1) Ethan posts 1-pager + SFDC snippets 2) Clara compiles AE contact list for escalation 3) Rina confirms NDA lock rules 4) Diego confirms marketplace tagging. If all green by EOD we go live.

Diego (Marketplace): Confirmed.

Rina (Legal): NDA rule confirmed.

Clara (Sales): AE contacts in progress.

Ethan (SI Ops): Will post in ~3h and ping here.

Maya (Partnerships): Thanks team 100. If anything changes ping this thread.
